name: CountFive_1
short_caption: The robot lifts its right hand, opening its fingers one by one to count to five before returning to a neutral posture.
movement_description: The robot starts by tilting its head slightly to the left and raising its right arm to chest level, turning its palm upward with a closed fist. It then gradually opens its fingers in a counting sequence while sweeping its right arm slightly outward and downward in a gentle arc. Finally, the robot brings its head back to center and lowers both arms back to a relaxed, neutral resting position at its sides.
safety_notes: The robot extends its right arm forward and slightly to the side. Ensure sufficient clearance on the right side of the robot to prevent contact with visitors or obstacles.
